capability: Accept an NT51950/NT51951 Standard CtrlRAM Base longer than its full-flash map (Display OSD) as a captured envelope that keeps every byte
searchEvidence: Owner decision 2026-09-26 (board decision 12, reaffirmed): NT51950 and NT51951 flash capacity is no longer fixed because of Display OSD (see the NT51950 AB Code family); remove the hard size limits; all 1.1.12 content must ship.

The NT51950/NT51951 Standard Merge profiles already declare the Display OSD source envelope (schema 2.16): layout template 256 KiB, expectedOuterLengths 262144, 524288 and 1048576, unexpectedLengthIssueCode DP_NONSTANDARD_SIZE_WARNING. The 1.1.11 record OSD-AB-REFERENCE-ENVELOPE-1111-01 accepted a longer AB CtrlRAM Base in code only, keeping the map as a layout template and projecting the tail.

Investigation (read-only, 2026-09-26): CtrlRAM Replace enforces Base length equal to a map capacity at adapter admission, route identity, map selection and plan output initialization; the processor reads and writes only inside [0, 0x37000); the NT51950 2-IC cascade full-flash map declares 262144 while the owner's AUTO_PRJ-599 950 cascade case is 0x80000 bytes.
semanticOwner: BuiltInCtrlRamAuthoringAdapter owns CtrlRAM Base admission; CanonicalDynamicRouteInventory owns route identity; TrustedProfileBundleCatalog and V2CompositionPlanCompiler own map selection and the runtime reference-replace plan; the IC's published Standard Merge source-envelope declaration owns which longer lengths are expected.
terminalContract: For a CtrlRAM Replace Base whose length equals a declared map capacity, behavior is unchanged. When no map matches and the IC's published Standard Merge profile declares a source envelope, a Base longer than the route's largest (full-flash) Standard CtrlRAM map is admitted as a captured envelope: that map is the layout template and the runtime compilation context carries the template capacity as a typed extent; route identity, published fingerprints and the runtime proof keep the template capacity; the output is initialized from the complete Base; lengths outside the envelope's expectedOuterLengths add its unexpectedLengthIssueCode as a warning. Declared write ranges and processor write authority are not enlarged, and every byte of [templateCapacity, baseLength) must be byte-identical in the output. Header and CRC results inside the template are proven only by complete-output Golden comparison and an exact write-range and tail audit, including the owner's independent 0x80000 AUTO_PRJ-599 expected output on the NT51950 2-IC cascade route. The Standard fallback never selects an AB map; AB keeps its own envelope path. ICs without a Standard Merge source envelope keep exact-length admission. Memory layout, report and input inspection presentation of the envelope tail is covered by a separate R1 record. No profile, schema, contract, trust-index, policy or expected-byte change.

designReview.evidence: 2026-09-26 independent R3 design review (read-only), ACCEPT-WITH-CHANGES, no P0: accept the full-flash map as a layout template and clone the complete captured Base. Incorporated: the runtime envelope context and input contract lowering paths are admitted; presentation paths move to a separate R1 record; canonical write authority stays unchanged; no claim of bounded external reads or unchanged CRC bytes without complete-output Golden comparison and an exact tail and write-range audit; the Standard fallback never selects an AB map.
